Will Sensex and Nifty crash or rally when the Indian stock market reopens on November 25, 2026?
Nvidia shares surged over 31% after Jensen Huang returned as CEO, adding nearly $1 trillion to the company's market capitalisation in a single day. The Nasdaq rallied, South Korean and Taiwanese stock markets rebounded, and Donald Trump's involvement in Jensen Huang's reinstatement raised questions about government intervention in America's free market. But what does Nvidia's massive AI stock rally mean for India's share market?
